extra.message: User-controlled parameters 'name' and 'password' are concatenated directly into an SQL statement executed via Statement.executeQuery(). No parameterization or validation is applied, allowing SQL injection (e.g. authentication bypass or extraction of the 'secret' column).

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: The 'uid' and 'password' request parameters are concatenated directly into an LDAP search filter passed to FilterParser.parse() without LDAP encoding. An attacker can inject filter syntax to bypass authentication.

cwe: CWE-90: LDAP Injection

extra.message: The user-supplied 'jsonString' parameter is concatenated into a JavaScript expression passed to ScriptEngine.eval(). This allows arbitrary code/script injection and potentially remote code execution on the JVM.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: The user-supplied 'expression' parameter is parsed and evaluated as an OGNL expression via Ognl.parseExpression()/Ognl.getValue() with no sandboxing. OGNL expression injection permits arbitrary method invocation and remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Code Injection
CWE-917: Expression Language Injection

extra.message: The user-supplied 'string' parameter is reversed and written directly into the HTML response without output encoding, resulting in reflected cross-site scripting.

cwe: CWE-79: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)

extra.message: The 'goto' request parameter is passed directly to HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect() without validation, allowing an attacker to redirect authenticated users to an arbitrary external site (open redirect / phishing).

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: For the /xxe endpoint the only hardening applied is FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING=true, which does not disable external general entities/DTDs. The uploaded XML is parsed with parser.parse(), so an attacker can supply a DOCTYPE referencing an external DTD/entity to read local files or perform SSRF (XML External Entity).

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: For the /xee endpoint only external entities and external DTD loading are disabled; internal entity expansion is left enabled with no expansion limit, so a crafted XML document (e.g. billion laughs) causes exponential entity expansion and denial of service.

cwe: CWE-776: Improper Restriction of Recursive Entity References in DTDs ('XML Entity Expansion')

extra.message: The user-controlled 'subject' (and message body) parameters are passed unsanitized to EmailUtils.sendEmailWithAttachment(), which calls MimeMessage.setSubject(). CR/LF characters are not stripped, enabling mail header injection (adding arbitrary headers/recipients).

cwe: CWE-93: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')

extra.message: The uploaded file name/extension is not validated (only blank check) before MultiPartFileUtils.writeFile() saves it under the web-accessible 'uploadFiles' directory. An attacker can upload a JSP/script file and achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

extra.message: The servlet uses @MultipartConfig without maxFileSize/maxRequestSize limits, so arbitrarily large image uploads are accepted and written to disk, allowing resource exhaustion (disk/memory) denial of service.

cwe: CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

extra.message: The uploaded part's file name is taken from the Content-Disposition header and passed to new File(fileName)/new FileOutputStream() without sanitization, so a name containing '../' or an absolute path causes arbitrary file write on the server.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: The 'fileName' parameter is concatenated into a file path with only a '.pdf' suffix appended. A null byte in the parameter (or path traversal sequences) can truncate/escape the intended 'pdf' directory and disclose arbitrary local files.

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal
CWE-158: Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character

extra.message: The 'pingurl' request parameter is used to build a URL that is opened via HttpURLConnection with no allow-list or validation, allowing server-side request forgery against internal services.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: The 'template' request parameter is concatenated into a c:import URL with only a check that it does not start with 'http'. A value such as '../../WEB-INF/...' allows path traversal and inclusion of arbitrary server-side files (also repeated at line 60 for the footer).

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal
CWE-98: Improper Control of Filename for Include/Require Statement

extra.message: The X-FRAME-OPTIONS header is deliberately omitted for /admins/clickjacking, and the ClickJackingServlet does not set it either, leaving the admin page framable and vulnerable to clickjacking.

cwe: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

extra.message: The doPost handler changes the logged-in user's password based solely on session state and a submitted password, with no CSRF token or origin/referer verification, so a forged cross-site request can change the password.

cwe: CWE-352: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)

extra.message: On successful authentication the existing session is reused and the session id is never regenerated/invalidated, allowing session fixation: an attacker who fixes a session id before login can hijack the authenticated session.

cwe: CWE-384: Session Fixation

extra.message: This login endpoint calls authUser() without any account-lockout or rate-limiting check (unlike DefaultLoginServlet), allowing unlimited password guessing against accounts.

cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

extra.message: Distinct error messages are returned depending on whether the user does not exist, the password format is wrong, or the password does not match. This verbose error handling discloses valid user IDs to an attacker.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: Multiple hardcoded user accounts and plaintext passwords (including privileged 'admin'/'password' records) are embedded in source code, exposing credentials in the repository.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: Hardcoded LDAP administrator accounts and plaintext passwords (admin/password, admin2/pas2w0rd, ...) are created from source code, exposing credentials in the repository.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: A world-readable web resource exposes plaintext administrator credentials (admin/password, admin2/pas2w0rd, admin3/pa33word, admin4/pathwood) that match the LDAP accounts.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: The default servlet is configured with listings=true, enabling directory listing and exposing the web application's file structure to unauthenticated users.

cwe: CWE-548: Exposure of Information Through Directory Listing
CWE-16: Configuration

extra.message: The serverinfo.jsp page dumps all JVM system properties (System.getProperties()) to the response, potentially leaking secrets such as file paths, configuration and credentials to authenticated users.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: User records (id/name/phone/mail) read from the request are written into HTML input 'value' attributes without output encoding, allowing stored/reflected cross-site scripting.

cwe: CWE-79: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)

extra.message: The session 'userid' value is written into the admin page HTML without encoding. Since the userId originates from the login request parameter (and LDAP injection permits arbitrary values), this enables cross-site scripting.

cwe: CWE-79: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)

extra.message: A GET request to /infiniteloop enters an unconditional while(true) loop that never terminates and never returns a response, permanently consuming a request-processing thread and enabling denial of service.

cwe: CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
CWE-835: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')

extra.message: A user-controlled string is matched against the vulnerable regex '^([a-z0-9]+[-]{0,1}){1,100}$' with catastrophic backtracking, allowing a small input to cause excessive CPU consumption (ReDoS).

cwe: CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
CWE-1333: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

extra.message: On any server-side exception the exception message and localized message are appended to the HTML response, disclosing internal implementation/SQL details to the client.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
